title: Redline EX vs. Escort iX? | Radar Detector & Countermeasure Forum
snippet:
Yeah $400 may be the sweet spot for it. Yeah there's the DFR7 at just under $300, but once you add Bluetooth, an OLED display, and autolockouts, autobrightness, a more frequently updated RLC database, and a few other little odds and ends, I could certainly see the appeal for the extra $100 or so. At that price you're running directly against the R3.  
   
 At $500, you're looking at $100 more over the R3 for less performance, likely worse BSM filtering, but you get the automation stuff. [...] - - - Updated - - -

> If I was buying an Escort unit (which I'm not, and won't) I would pay the extra $100 for the K band segmentation, RDD immunity, range over the IX, and potential future proofing of MRCD detection.

Now that said, the price needs to come down on the iX if they want to sell these things, no question about it!

title: Best Radar Detectors of 2026: Expert Reviews & Buyer's Guide
snippet:
The Escort Redline 360c is a top pick for a long range and easy to use radar detector, especially for your everyday driver. It’s a long range detector with arrows, excellent false alert filtering, and some of the best hands-free automation. It ticks nearly every box you could want in terms of features and capabilities. [...] Long range detection is in the same ballpark as the Escort Redline 360c and the Uniden R8w. It’s also very responsive against instant on radar on Ka like the R8w, but it performs more like the Redline 360c on K band. It also struggles against some lower powered radar guns too like the Kustom Falcon HR and Raptor RP-1. [...] ### Uniden R8w

Uniden R8wIf you’re looking for a long range radar detector that excels against all types of police radar, has GPS built-in, decent false alert filtering, arrows, a large display, photo radar detection, and a variety of third-party app options purchase the Uniden R8w.

 ### Escort Redline 360c

Escort Redline 360cFor the everyday driver wanting a high end yet simpler experience, purchase the Escort Redline 360c.

title: Best Radar Detectors 2026: Expert Reviews & Ultimate Buyer’s Guide
snippet:
Cedar Electronics, the parent company of both Escort and Cobra, made their first foray into a combination radar detector and dash camera several years ago with the attractive and now discontinued Cobra Road Scout. With the new Escort MAXcam 360c, Escort fans now have an integrated dash camera and high performance police radar detector and police laser detector.

#### ✅ Pros [...] #### ✅ Pros

 Slated to get a significant firmware update to improve detection performance in the very near future
 Class-leading filtering of radar based collision avoidance systems
 Escort’s best radar detector and dash cam combo
 Exceptional police laser sensitivity
 High quality video dash camera
 Pricey (but goes on sale often)

#### ❌ Cons

 Display is small and hard to read
 DriveSmarter often hangs/disconnects [...] #### ✅ Pros

 Among the best for highway driving
 Exceptionally responsive to instant-on radar

#### ❌ Cons

 Plastic casing feels less substantial
 Laser detection could be better
 Filtering of radar based collision avoidance trails Escort’s and the Cobra RAD 700i (tends to false to Mazda vehicles)
 Pricey
